tasks.short: Advise recreation and fitness students on curricula and careers.

steps.what: Find actual recreation and fitness curriculum requirements and relevant career resources
inputs: actual student questions and programme requirements
actual current career resources

steps.what: Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and actual career issues
inputs: checked relevant advising sources
actual student goals, circumstances and questions
outputs: actual student advice and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Record and check actual advising follow-up where an advising record is required
inputs: actual student advice and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Save the checked actual advising record
inputs: checked final actual advising record

tasks.design: Configure native programme and career-resource links in {LMS} and {DOCS}. The teacher verifies sources, retains actual advising and captures any actual required follow-up record before a separate checked save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advising preparation can repeat programme/resource navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-resource links can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Useful advice depends on actual student circumstances and goals.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when a standard pathway does not suit the student.
tasks.altitude: Less advising lookup; student conversation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native programme/resource links can support advising preparation; they do not choose an appropriate student pathway.

assumptions: Actual programme/career owners supply current resources; teacher checks relevance in s1. Student supplies actual needs during s2; no free captured student profile or automatic advice is assumed.
Record branch applies only to an actual existing requirement; if none exists omit and reweight. Actual conversation, new note capture and full check remain retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final check. Shared office-hour advising is counted once with 6427; actual written follow-up sends must be separate final-version-gated actions.
research_questions: Can native links reduce lookup without reducing student conversation?

incremental.description: Maintain actual programme and career-resource links.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual advising record and exact student destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Advising, capture/check and save retained.

steps.what: Retrieve actual student teaching, internship or research work and supervision requirements
inputs: actual student work and placement/research requirements
actual supervision objectives

steps.what: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work through actual review and discussion
inputs: checked actual supervision context
actual observed work and student questions
outputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

steps.what: Write and check actual student feedback and supervision follow-up
inputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback
outputs: checked final actual supervision feedback and student destination

steps.what: Save the checked actual supervision feedback
inputs: checked final actual supervision feedback and student destination

steps.what: Deliver the exact checked written feedback to the actual supervised student
inputs: checked final actual supervision feedback and student destination

tasks.design: Configure native student-work links and supervision feedback fields in {LMS}, {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. The teacher retains observation, supervision judgement and chosen feedback; only repeated identifiers/headings shrink before complete final checking and separate save/delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision can repeat work navigation and standard feedback headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked work and feedback fields can reduce repetitive administration.
tasks.still_hard: Supervision quality depends on actual performance and student interaction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes safe independent practice from a student needing closer support.
tasks.altitude: Less supervision administration; judgement remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student-work links and feedback fields can reduce repeated navigation and headings; they do not assess teaching, internship or research performance.

assumptions: Actual students/placement owners supply work and requirements, checked in s1. Teacher performs actual observation and selects feedback in s2. Retained s3 captures actual new feedback and checks complete final meaning; no free structured observations.

Teaching, internship and research are alternative supervision branches, not mandatory duplicate events. Actual written feedback/save/delivery branches only; oral-only supervision removes these and reweights.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; existing automated headings earn zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent and consume existing final check; actual assessment decisions remain fully retained.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce administration after complete feedback checking?

already_counted.description: Capture actual supervision feedback and check final meaning in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual student-work links and supervision fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual feedback and exact supervision record destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final actual feedback and exact supervised student destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation + 18*0.20 repeated fields = 7.6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.1. Half eligible gives 3.8 minus 0.5 = 3.3. Observation, feedback meaning, final check, save and send retained.

tasks.short: Hold regular office hours to advise students.

steps.what: Enter and check actual regularly scheduled office hours in the existing calendar
inputs: actual office-hour schedule and student access details
outputs: checked final actual office-hour calendar entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked office-hour schedule
inputs: checked final actual office-hour calendar entry

steps.what: Maintain actual regularly scheduled office hours to advise and assist students
inputs: saved actual office-hour availability
actual student attendance, needs and questions
outputs: actual available office hours and student assistance

tasks.design: Use existing recurring entries in {CALENDAR} for actual office-hour availability. Keep schedule entry/save explicit and fully retained; actual student access, advising and assistance remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task primarily requires actual availability and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendar recurrence already supports the small schedule transaction.
tasks.still_hard: Students need actual access to their teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to individual student uncertainty and circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Office hours remain direct student access.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing recurring calendar entries can represent office hours; they do not supply student advising or assistance.

assumptions: Actual teacher supplies and checks schedule in s1; save is separate and retained. Occasional schedule entry is counted once per actual change, not per session/student; shares are provisional, not measured baselines.

After splitting actual schedule write, there is no new saving beyond existing recurrence. No mandatory notes, report or send is specified by maintaining office hours; actual advising records/resource preparation are counted once under 6431 rather than invented here.
Native recurrence first; existing automation earns zero saving. Actual student interaction and availability remain fully retained. No new system or upkeep is proposed.
research_questions: Does any actual administrative work remain beyond the existing schedule?

incremental.description: No new configuration or ongoing work proposed.

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final actual office-hour entry and exact calendar destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 100 provisional hours retained; existing recurrence is not new saving. No new upkeep.

tasks.short: Research recreation and fitness topics and publish findings.

steps.what: Find and verify actual recreation and fitness research literature and study source records
inputs: actual research question
actual original publications and study records

steps.what: Conduct actual research, collect and analyze evidence and determine defensible findings
inputs: checked actual research sources
actual research design, participants or study materials
outputs: actual observed data, interpreted findings and limitations

steps.what: Write research findings for actual professional journal, book or electronic publication
inputs: actual observed data, interpreted findings and limitations
checked actual research sources
actual venue and author requirements

loop.purpose: Draft publication prose from actual author findings
loop.input: Actual findings, interpretation, checked sources and venue requirements
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific meaning, numerical claims, omitted limitations, source fidelity and unsupported conclusions
loop.stop: Missing actual findings or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native venue headings and reference formatting first; explanations vary

steps.what: Check exact final publication version, author permissions and permitted venue destination
inputs: complete actual publication draft
actual observed data, interpreted findings and limitations
actual author permissions and applicable venue decision
outputs: checked final actual publication version and permitted destination

steps.what: Save the checked final actual publication version
inputs: checked final actual publication version and permitted destination

steps.what: Submit exact checked research findings to the actual journal or book publisher
inputs: checked final actual publication version and permitted destination
outputs: submitted actual findings for editorial consideration

steps.what: Publish exact checked findings in actual author-controlled electronic media when authorised
inputs: checked final actual publication version and permitted destination
actual electronic publication rights

tasks.design: Configure native research-library links in {OTHER} and venue/reference fields in {DOCS}, then bound prose drafting to actual author findings. The teacher retains research and interpretation, checks the complete final version and separately saves, submits or publishes through the actual authorised venue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Publication can repeat source discovery and prose after research findings exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded publication drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Research validity and defensible conclusions require actual investigation and author judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when a polished claim exceeds the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less publication drafting; research stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-library links and bounded source-linked drafting can support publication preparation; they do not conduct research or guarantee editorial acceptance.

assumptions: Actual original publishers/study owners supply sources; teacher checks them in s1 and performs actual research, primary capture, analysis and interpretation in s2. Statistical research software is {OTHER}; no automatic result discovery or free findings.
Retained s3 captures/corrects actual author meaning. Native venue/reference fields first; existing automation earns zero saving. Complete final scientific and permission checks stay retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Journal/book submission and author-controlled electronic publication are alternative actual routes; remove unused branches and reweight rather than assuming all venues. Submission does not mean acceptance or publication.

Editors control journal/book publication; no editor labour is counted as focal saving. Any requested revision repeats actual final check for the changed version before resubmission; actual publication rights/acceptance must exist before an electronic release.
Save, submission and electronic publication are distinct one-percent retained actions using the actual existing final-version check after complete content exists; no additional self-approval work.
unknowns: How much publication prose is repetitive?
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce writing after full scientific and permission review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual publication meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual source links, venue fields and scientific drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual publication version and exact internal destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual submission version, actual author permissions and exact venue destination; edits void approval
s4 checked final actual electronic version, actual publication rights and exact authorised medium; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 source navigation + 20*0.30 prose = 10; minus 1.5 upkeep = 8.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 1.5 = 3.5. Research, full final review, save and release actions retained.
